(i) Racing Victoria loans to the Ballarat Turf Club and Wangaratta Turf Club were novated to Country Racing Victoria at market value.

(ii) Racing Victoria has advanced $4.000 million to Cranbourne Pakenham Racing Club. This loan is connected with a Call Option Deed and will convert to the consideration for the acquisition of development land at Pakenham racecourse following its formal sub-division and title.

(iii) Racing Victoria provided loans to Victoria Racing Club and Cranbourne Pakenham Racing Club. Loan principals of $10.000 million and $4.506 million respectively are provided at discount-to-market rates on deferred repayment terms and are recognised at amortised cost. Repayment timing and discount rates are reviewed and adjusted annually.

(iv) Racing Victoria has provided a loan to Sports Wagering Integrity Monitoring Ltd (SWIM) to fund the capital costs of developing a transaction level wagering and betting monitoring system. Interest is being capitalised at market rates.
